mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_token (USER_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRE_DATE, USED_YN, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{expireDate}, 'N', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, USER_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRE_DATE, USED_YN, REG_DATE FROM password_reset_token WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRE_DATE > NOW() ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_token SET USED_YN = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USED_YN = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM password_reset_token WHERE EXPIRE_DATE < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
